text:
Taylor: dropped a prototype exploring a p95 overlay that can toggle between 'step' and 'smooth' rendering. trying to reduce visual noise when heatmap density is low. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/new-p95/overlay-proto (image attached)
Jordan: nice. main question: when smooth is on, do we risk misleading users about exact bucket boundaries? might be okay for exploration but not for precise troubleshooting.
Sam: agree. proposal: default to step for diagnostics, add a small toggle labelled 'Smooth (explore)' so it's opt-in. keep step for screenshots / share links.
Priya: accessibility note: the p95 overlay line currently uses amber which is low contrast on the heatmap. suggest using the token "chart-900" (darker) or adding a 2px halo stroke to improve visibility.
Jess: also suggest an option to 'show histogram bins' when zoomed in. tiny vertical bars under the minimap help eyeballing bucket sizes without altering main chart density.
Diego: impl note: rendering both histogram bars and smooth line might be heavy. we can composite the histogram as an alpha mask on a single canvas layer. will prototype.
Taylor: UX question about the legend: should we allow toggling the p95 overlay from the legend and show a tiny help hint: "p95 overlay uses same aggregation as chart"? helps clarity for new users.
Jordan: yes to legend control. micro-copy for the hint: "p95: 95th percentile of latency for visible requests." short and direct.
Sam: sampling control thought: add an inline micro-toggle "Auto-sample (cost-aware)" next to the timepicker. if on, show current sampling rate in the legend like "sampling: 1s (adaptive)".
Priya: copy nit: avoid technical words in UI. maybe "Smart sampling" instead of Auto-sample. hover help: "Reduces resolution during quiet periods to save compute." link to docs.
Jess: keyboard accessibility: legend toggles need to be reachable via Tab and togglable with Space/Enter. announce state change via aria-live: "p95 overlay hidden" or "shown".
Diego: perf note: if users pin a long range and enable histogram, we should cap histogram resolution server-side to avoid huge payloads. That complexity belongs in the backend, but UI should warn: "High range may reduce detail."
Taylor: new micro-feature idea: allow adding an annotation to a selected range with a short note (e.g., "deploy 2025-01-14") that shows as a tiny badge on the top timeline. useful for correlating p95 spikes to releases. thoughts?
Jordan: yes! needs small UI: when selection is pinned show an "Add note" button next to "Apply to dashboard". annotation modal simple: timestamp range + short text. persisted to user metadata.
Sam: for export/share we should include annotations in the share link or snapshot. also include which sampling mode was active.
Priya: accessibility for annotations: ensure they have accessible names and focus targets. clicking badge should open the annotation panel and focus the textarea.
Jess: copy for annotation button: "Add note to timeline". SR text when created: "Annotation added: deploy 2025-01-14" via aria-live assertive.
Diego: implementation constraints: annotation storage should be per-dashboard, not global, and respect RBAC. backend stub needed. I'll sync with Product.
Taylor: next steps: I'll update the mock with step/smooth toggle, darker p95 stroke + halo, histogram mini-bars on zoom, legend toggle, smart sampling micro-toggle copy, and annotation CTA. will post Figma update tomorrow AM. tagging @Diego @Jess @Priya for implementation + a11y review. :rocket:
Sam: thanks! will prototype canvas composition and share perf numbers.
Jordan: linking a quick doc on percentiles for copy team: /docs/observability/percentiles (helps consistent phrasing).
Jess: sounds good. i'll draft the aria-live snippets and include keyboard examples in the help center.
